_doc: CVE allowlist for npm audit. Every entry MUST have an expiry. CI fails if any entry is expired OR if a high+/critical CVE exists outside this allowlist. Owner: Henry. Maintenance: review monthly.

allowlist.reason: Missing buffer bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when buf arg is provided. Exploit path requires caller to pass a pre-allocated buffer to uuid; codebase NEVER invokes uuid with buf (verified Phase A pre-go-live audit 2026-06-19). exceljs (the consumer) uses uuid only via v4 random API which does not accept buf. Fix requires exceljs major bump (3.x → 4.x) which spans the xlsx export pipeline; deferred to dep-bump sprint Q4 2026.

allowlist.reason: Jest 29.7.0 is dev-only test runner; --omit=dev excludes from runtime audit. Fix requires Jest major bump 29 → 30 (semver-major) which changes test API surface. Already covered by root job's --omit=dev flag; this entry documents the chain for review cadence. Schedule Jest 30 bump alongside React 19 testing infrastructure setup (S-TEST-INFRA, Q1 2027).
